command:
set -o pipefail
echo '=== HOST ==='
printf 'host='; hostname
printf 'user='; whoami
printf 'time='; date -Is

repo="/home/ai-core-node/.cache/omegacv1-main-93a44ca-canonical-stage"
echo '=== OMEGA REPO ==='
if [ -d "$repo/.git" ]; then
  printf 'head='; git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD
  printf 'branch='; git -C "$repo" branch --show-current
  printf 'origin_main='; git -C "$repo" rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '-- status --'
  git -C "$repo" status --short | head -80
  echo '-- recent commits --'
  git -C "$repo" log -8 --date=iso-strict --pretty=format:'%h %ad %s'
else
  echo 'repo_missing'
fi

state="$HOME/.local/share/omegacv1/runtime/omega/state.json"
echo
echo '=== CANONICAL STATE ==='
python3 - "$state" <<'PY'
import json,sys,os
p=sys.argv[1]
if not os.path.exists(p):
    print("state_missing")
    raise SystemExit
s=json.load(open(p))
print("path="+p)
for k in ("entity_id","revision","active_goal_id","last_turn_id","concurrent_reentry"):
    print(f"{k}={s.get(k)}")
turns=s.get("turns") or []
print("turn_count="+str(len(turns)))
for t in turns[-5:]:
    print("turn", {k:t.get(k) for k in ("run_id","status","goal_ref","turn_id","predecessor_turn_id") if k in t})
g=s.get("grid_cell_state")
if isinstance(g,dict):
    print("grid_cell_state_keys="+",".join(sorted(g.keys())[:40]))
    for k in ("revision","last_updated","selected_cell","active_cell","state","complexity"):
        if k in g: print(f"grid.{k}={g.get(k)}")
else:
    print("grid_cell_state_type="+type(g).__name__)
print("top_keys="+",".join(sorted(s.keys())))
PY

echo '=== PROCESSES ==='
pgrep -a -f 'omegacv1|omega-genesis|omega-terminal|crush' | head -40 || true

echo '=== BUILD/RELEASE ==='
for p in "$HOME/.local/share/omegacv1-test-platform/releases/f02481f42895e7876948009382c770887f74ac51/omegacv1" "$repo/dist/omegacv1"; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then stat -c '%n size=%s mtime=%y' "$p"; else echo "missing $p"; fi
done
